info.name: Ron Swanson Quotes Get Random Quote

items.docs: Return a single random Ron Swanson quote wrapped in a one-element JSON array of strings. Equivalent to calling /quotes/1.

info.name: Ron Swanson Quotes Get Random Quotes

params.name: count
params.description: Number of random quotes to return.

items.docs: Return a JSON array of `count` random Ron Swanson quotes. The service does not document an upper bound on `count`; reasonable values are in the low tens. Negative or non-integer values yield a single quote.

params.name: term
params.description: URL-encoded search term. Matched against the quote corpus without case sensitivity. Whole-word matching is not enforced - substrings also match.

items.docs: Return every Ron Swanson quote whose text contains the URL-escaped `term` substring. Matching is case-insensitive. The response is an array of zero or more quote strings; an empty array is returned when no quotes match.
